arms.lora_r27gen: 3.8's recipe (r15_consolidate --lora, rank 16, 1000 steps, seed 0) on the demo + the v2 generator's successes (g27, states 0-19); the policy acts from images
arms.phasebind2_nofold: rules v2, bindings alone through the frozen prior, simulator object poses (oracle)
arms.phasebind2_reader: rules v2 with the first-frame learned pose reader (experiments/p6_reader.py; readers of all 21 tasks, trained on states 0-29); no simulator state reaches the server

metrics.defect: the living-room demos' first kept steps catch the object still FALLING after the scene spawned (ketchup 12.2 cm, milk and orange juice 8.4 cm above rest); v1 anchored the approach on that pose, so the retargeted grasp aimed under the object (48 and 58: 0 of 40 through the prior)
metrics.dev_evidence: no-policy generator on the practice init states 0-19 (ledger g38_generate tag demo_retarget_v2): v2 386/420 vs v1 331/420, gains only on 42, 48, 52, 58, no task lower; the scoring states 30-49 were not used

hypotheses.V1: PRIMARY: phasebind2_nofold > phasebind_nofold (v1, 314/420): exact two-sided sign test
hypotheses.V2: phasebind2_nofold > nft_bal (LoRA + failure negatives, 302/420; 0 weights vs 18.7 MB per task): exact two-sided sign test
hypotheses.V3: phasebind2_reader non-inferior to phasebind2_nofold at -0.10: one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired difference (two-level bootstrap) >= -0.10
hypotheses.V4: lora_r27gen > lora_r25gen (293/420): exact two-sided sign test
hypotheses.descriptive: per task; phasebind2_reader and lora_r27gen vs nft_bal; bytes
hypotheses.holm: Holm over V1, V2, V4 at 0.05

metrics.later: a near-object re-read of the pose (experiments/p6_near_reader.py) gets its own pre-registration before any rollout
metrics.plan: docs/PLAN_TRANSFER.md section 0: iterate on the binding route; v2 fixes a defect found after the P1/P6/3.8 reads
metrics.rules_v2: lifelong_ood/policy/phase.py at_rest + cut: (1) the demo's objects read at rest (the evaluation placements' convention); (2) the manipulated object = the first movable object DISPLACED > 1.5 cm while the gripper commands close (lifted or pushed); (3) the carry and the rest anchored on the other object of interest, movable OR fixture; (4) a demo that moves no object is anchored on its object of interest (a fixture) instead of the world
metrics.tasks: the 21 held-out tasks where the prior fails its practice; init states 30-49; 420 paired episodes per arm (m3_final)
metrics.written_before: any rollout of these arms at init states 30-49
